test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 6 March 2023)
subject: general
question: In a code language, 'PLUMAGE' is written as ‘GICOWNR’ and 'CRUSH' is written as 'JUWTE'. How will 'TRIBAL' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- (2) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic diagonally.

​So,

 
• 'PLUMAGE' is written as ‘GICOWNR’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d509af0efb4b7cf05f08c570f34088c835094eec77a014e9aaa836cdaff8f82.png] 

And,

 
• 'CRUSH' is written as 'ETWUJ' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0dc20417a14b762bf4ddce21bf8362987c928384b9db3efaf9267a4b380a80f5.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'TRIBAL' is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/479c0a3f94e0c6201436ec23d02384003b4af84d534fa732c668dc536d38d535.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**NCDKTV**".
